message.content: We are asked: "Reply with OK." The instruction is simple. We just need to output "OK". However, the system prompt is a long cache probe prefix. It says: "You are a cache usage probe. The following deterministic prefix must be kept identical across repeated requests." Then it lists many lines of "flowdown-cache-probe-..." followed by a number. Then the user message is "Reply with OK." So I should just reply with "OK". No need to include the prefix in my response; the prefix is part of the system prompt, not part of the response. I'll just output "OK".
